**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 07:07  
[USER] User requested a data model for a loyalty program based on data-enriched tokens.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A loyalty program based on data-enriched tokens can utilize a combination of on-chain and off-chain data to manage and track customer interactions, rewards, and redemptions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Suggested data model includes the following entities and their attributes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] User: user_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, date_of_birth, registration_date, address (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Token: token_id, token_name, token_symbol, total_supply, decimals, smart_contract_address.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wallet: wallet_id, user_id (foreign key, related to User), public_key, private_key (encrypted).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] TokenBalance: token_balance_id, wallet_id (foreign key, related to Wallet), token_id (foreign key, related to Token), balance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Transaction: transaction_id, sender_wallet_id (foreign key, related to Wallet), receiver_wallet_id (foreign key, related to Wallet), token_id (foreign key, related to Token), amount, transaction_fee, timestamp, transaction_hash, status (pending, success, failed).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Reward: reward_id, token_id (foreign key, related to Token), reward_name, description, required_tokens, reward_image (optional), start_date, end_date.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] RewardRedemption: redemption_id, user_id (foreign key, related to User), reward_id (foreign key, related to Reward), redemption_date, status (pending, success, failed).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Merchant: merchant_id, merchant_name, email, phone_number, address.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] MerchantTokenAllocation: allocation_id, merchant_id (foreign key, related to Merchant), token_id (foreign key, related to Token), allocation_amount, start_date, end_date.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This data model captures the primary entities involved in a data-enriched token-based loyalty program, including users, tokens, wallets, transactions, rewards, redemptions, and merchants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested RESTful API endpoints to manage the data model include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] User API: POST /users, GET /users, GET /users/{user_id}, PUT /users/{user_id}, DELETE /users/{user_id}.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Token API: POST /tokens, GET /tokens, GET /tokens/{token_id}, PUT /tokens/{token_id}, DELETE /tokens/{token_id}.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wallet
